title: lycopodium spurium var. glaucescens
intro: Lycopodium spurium var. glaucescens, commonly known as Fern Wintergreen, is a plant species that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium spurium var. glaucescens include stimulating circulation, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting expectoration, making it a valuable remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
